subject.title: [Bug]: Discord media uploads lose content-type and animated images lose frames

question: Should maintainers continue the open linked PR as the canonical fix path, replace it with a narrower branch, or allow a new ClawSweeper fix PR after that PR is resolved?
rationale: The bug is valid and has an open closing PR, but that PR still needs maintainer handling for proof and media/API contract concerns; automation should not create a competing fix while it remains active.

options.title: Keep the linked PR canonical
options.body: Resolve proof and contract blockers on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41265, then close this issue through the merged fix.

options.title: Replace with a narrower PR
options.body: If the current branch is too stale or broad, open a fresh narrow replacement that credits the source work before closing the linked PR.

options.title: Permit a new ClawSweeper fix later
options.body: Only after the linked PR is closed or abandoned should ClawSweeper queue a new focused fix PR for the same bug.

recommendation.title: Keep the linked PR canonical
recommendation.body: Resolve proof and contract blockers on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41265, then close this issue through the merged fix.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-main history across the Discord send, media, and plugin-SDK surfaces involved in the remaining decision.
